name: Runner Extras - NavApp GetResource
brief: Proves NavApp.GetResource / GetResourceAsText serve the app's packaged resources (app.json resourceFolders) and throw the real BC not-found error on a miss.
description: RED before the fix: ALNavApp.GetPackagedResource NREd on the skeleton's null CurrentMethodScope/OwningApp/NavAppMetadataRetriever chain, so any app calling NavApp.GetResource in an install trigger or test aborted (Pageworks RegisterBaselineFonts). GREEN after: the runner locates the resource bytes in the owning app's declared resourceFolders (source bundle) or /resources/ package part (.app dependency) and returns a real NavInStream; a missing name throws BC's own NavNclResourceNotFoundException text, never a silent default.
